g.text: SD05 - Acquisition visit and follow-up without orders (AD20 / AD21)
Inputs: company name, contact person, contact details,
visit address and actual visit date.
Register only after the visit has taken place.
Eligible only if the most recent visit was at least
ONE CALENDAR MONTH ago and no order was placed.
An existing customer account without orders is eligible.
Display overview: all eligible companies together with
their contact persons and contact details.
Do not include pharmacies that already ordered.
Show that no follow-ups are currently due.
Call and offer 10% on first order if an account may be created
[Interested and gives permission to create or reuse account]
Transfer company name, billing/delivery addresses and incentive
[Customer account already exists without an order]
Record one-time incentive on existing account
existing account reused; no duplicate account
Consent given, valid billing and delivery addresses.
account linked; incentive will apply only once on first order
Record missing consent; do not create an account or grant discount.
Record refusal and stop follow-up; no further contact.
